review_type: independent internal proof and exact-source review
proof_findings: The traffic material and direction are designated at fresh allocation; the online mark occurs before any alias of that index has a private step result.

Fixed index-order hybrids retain a real suffix after an earlier mark. The predecessor mark is already decided when the next private seed is allocated, so challenge embedding does not depend on a future decision.
Exact HKDF block-table normalization removes the hidden successor seed from its parent row before that seed is used as the next column challenge.
Each hidden seed has only the declared zero-salt extraction use. Each resulting Extract handle has two adaptive row uses with exact message lengths 57 and 89 bytes.
Never-reached steps leave their primitive challenge unused. Whole-execution query budgets remain deterministic and include preparation, the real suffix and terminal evaluation.
The joint root/traffic comparison is charged once, followed by two comparisons per potential prefix index. Numerical collisions remain in the shared-oracle experiments.
The AEAD challenger key can be installed after an online mark and before the pair is generated. Earlier key observations and the disclosed successor are available to the reduction.
First private encryption populates the original-operation ledger before a later persistence failure; exact retries consume one encryption query.
The confidentiality score incurs twice the bit-comparison cost; selected-message integrity uses one Boolean-event comparison.
Native end-to-end next-rekey statements retain their original first-message interface. The new result supplies the explicitly declared finite-chain continuation and application reductions.
review_corrections: Clarified that pending and failed transaction resumption retains the proof ledger; the statement does not add an adversarial whole-storage rollback contract.
Made never-reached challenge handling and unconditional whole-execution budgets explicit.
The eight four-symbol policies use distinct masks of the first disclosed key; repeated offset classes were removed before finalization.
scope: The proof was reviewed statement by statement. The executed finite controls check the declared ideal-selection and interface properties and exact source identities; they retain their finite scope.

visual_review.result: readable text and equations, consistent margins and section transitions, no observed clipping or overlap
